summary: Medline Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a refinancing transaction conducted by its indirect subsidiaries. On May 28, 2026, subsidiaries issued $1.25B of 5.000% senior secured notes due 2031 and $750M of 5.250% senior secured notes due 2033, alongside a new $2.75B term loan facility. Proceeds repaid existing debt, including term loans due 2028 and 2030 and $500M of 6.250% notes due 2029. The notes and guarantees are secured on a pari passu basis. This is a routine debt management action with no change in corporate control or ownership structure, reflecting balance sheet optimization.
